  • 日本語名: 陵辱学園 ～巨乳姉妹調教授業～
  • 英語名: Ryoujoku Gakuen Kyonyuu Shimai Choukyou Jugyou

别名

  • ××学園～巨乳姉妹○教授業～

あらすじ

Zenichiro takes advantage of Ayako’s weakness and coerces her into having S&M sex every day.

But something is standing in between them. It is Ayako’s younger sister and class representative, Mamiko.

Zenichiro initially disregards Mamiko, but then one night he is witness to the secret between Ayako and Mamiko.

item.title: Oyako Ryoujoku Maid Kissa
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Trans, Mischievous
  • 発売日: 2008-06-14
  • スコア: 6.33/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 母娘陵辱メイド喫茶
  • 英語名: Oyako Ryoujoku Maid Kissa

あらすじ

There is a small cafe. One day, the cafe is renovated and opened. As a matter of fact, Kenji, the main character, planned to change the cafe and collect customers by giving physical services without telling Ryoko, an owner of the cafe, and Megumi, Ryoko’s daughter, about it. Just one day before its opening, he tells them about it and they agree to it. Like this, the cafe opens….
